title: Sources for algebraic elimination and further proof theory
details: For later algebraic applications, Marker’s Model Theory II: Quantifier Elimination (2020-10-14), slides 1–13, remains an orientation source; inspect the actual algebraic prerequisites and proofs before adoption. Select sources for Harrop-antecedent extraction with the exact witness provisos. Obtain complete sources for equality-free first-order interpolation, varying-domain intuitionistic completeness, logical-equality-preserving cut transformations and general Herbrand extraction with quantified contraction. The general proof in Buss’s 1995 Herbrand article has a contraction defect; its separate weak leading-existential fragment does not justify the unrestricted theorem. Select sources for terminating G4ip search, quantitative cut bounds, and strong normalization and confluence for a specified local natural-deduction reduction relation. Constructive arithmetic source selection remains for Friedman translations, realizability, numerical existence and disjunction extraction, provably total functions, primitive recursive arithmetic and ordinal analysis.
